name: Viby.chat (Guest 1-on-1 Text)
protection_summary: Free guest mode allows up to 10 chats per day per browser session; clear profile storage to reset.

selectors.composer_input: textarea:not([disabled]), input[type="text"][placeholder*="message" i]:not([disabled]), input[type="text"][placeholder*="write" i]:not([disabled]), input[type="text"][placeholder*="type" i]:not([disabled]), #msg-input, #chat-input
selectors.skip_button: button.skip, button.next, button.leave-chat, button[aria-label*="Close" i], button[aria-label*="Skip" i]
selectors.chat_ended_text: user is offline|conversation ended|stranger disconnected|has left the room
